title: Meta Universe Map
subtitle: Metaverse, XR standards, 3D interoperability, digital twins and AI agents
disclaimer: “Meta Universe” here means the wider metaverse/spatial-computing ecosystem. Meta Platforms is one participant, not the definition of the ecosystem.

nodes.label: Meta Universe / Metaverse
nodes.description: Interoperable ecosystem of immersive worlds, spatial computing, digital twins, content and AI agents.

nodes.label: OpenXR
nodes.description: Royalty-free cross-platform XR API standard from Khronos.

nodes.label: WebXR
nodes.description: W3C web API for VR/AR device access and immersive web experiences.

nodes.label: glTF
nodes.description: Khronos runtime 3D asset delivery format for interoperable scenes and models.

nodes.label: OpenUSD
nodes.description: Open 3D scene description/interchange ecosystem standardized through AOUSD.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Omniverse
nodes.description: Development platform for OpenUSD-based 3D applications, simulation and services.

nodes.label: Meta Horizon ecosystem
nodes.description: Meta-branded social/immersive platform ecosystem; represented as one actor, not the whole metaverse.

nodes.label: Unreal Engine
nodes.description: Real-time 3D engine used for games, simulation and immersive experiences.

nodes.label: Unity
nodes.description: Real-time 3D engine used across games, XR and simulation.

nodes.label: Godot
nodes.description: Open-source game engine with OpenXR support.

nodes.label: XR devices
nodes.description: Headsets, controllers, trackers, spatial sensors and other immersive-computing devices.

nodes.label: Identity & avatars
nodes.description: Portable identity, avatars, reputation and account systems across virtual environments.

nodes.label: Commerce & ownership
nodes.description: Payments, digital goods, licensing and entitlement systems for virtual economies.

nodes.label: AI agents in 3D
nodes.description: Autonomous or assistive AI entities that navigate, create or operate within spatial environments.

nodes.label: World foundation models
nodes.description: Generative/simulation models for physical or virtual world dynamics and content.

nodes.label: Digital twins
nodes.description: Persistent virtual representations of physical assets, factories, cities or environments.

nodes.label: Spatial web
nodes.description: Web-accessible immersive experiences connected through browser and device standards.
